chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:
“Indeed, Fāṭimah, may the blessings of Allah be upon her, is not like any one of you. She does not see blood in menstruation nor in postnatal bleeding, like a heavenly maiden.”

key_terms.صَلَوَاتُ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهَا: a supplication invoking Allah’s blessings upon her
key_terms.فَاطِمَةَ: Fāṭimah, the daughter of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله say about the unique purity of Fāṭimah صلوات الله عليها?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a statement of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله concerning the unique status of Fāṭimah صلوات الله عليها. It describes her as unlike other women in that she does not experience menstrual or postnatal bleeding, presenting this as part of her special distinction.
